subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this xAI provider-side rotation error, should maintainers accept redacted pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative predicate tests as sufficient proof, or require organic after-fix xAI/Grok gateway logs before merge?
rationale: The repository proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof for external PRs, but the contributor explains that the exact code-less xAI error is provider-side and not client-inducible on demand.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the production logs, current-main source gap, bounded retry implementation, and focused tests as sufficient for this narrow non-inducible provider rotation bug.

options.title: Wait for organic proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real xAI/Grok rotation happens again and the contributor can attach redacted after-fix gateway logs from this branch.

options.title: Route to broader retry design
options.body: Pause this PR and decide whether to fold the xAI wording into a broader encrypted-content retry/error-classification change.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production logs, current-main source gap, bounded retry implementation, and focused tests as sufficient for this narrow non-inducible provider rotation bug.
